about:
Arkadia Plastics Inc. was founded in 1996 in New Britain, Connecticut. The company operates as a custom compounding specialist, though details about its founders or ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm provides custom compounding of thermoplastic materials, supported by an experienced engineering team. Its service portfolio includes extrusion technical services, moisture analysis, injection molding technical support, and broader technical consulting for both its own compounds and unrelated products. A quality control department supplies required certificates for customer orders. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

Arkadia serves medical and industrial markets, compounding customer‑specified products for a range of applications. Specific customer names or case studies are not provided in the available information.

The company emphasizes its identity as a service‑oriented organization with deep compounding expertise, citing over 30 years of technical service experience. It positions its technical support as a differentiator, offering assistance on materials beyond its own product line.
